name: qiongli-literature-provider
description: Qiongli academic literature provider MCPB for local OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar search, credential status, and secure setup.

tools.name: qiongli_literature_status
tools.description: Report configured literature providers and capability mode without exposing secrets.

tools.name: qiongli_config_status
tools.description: Report shared Qiongli provider configuration status without exposing secrets.

tools.name: qiongli_configure_provider
tools.description: Open a local browser-based setup page for Qiongli provider credentials without exposing secrets in chat.

tools.name: qiongli_save_provider_config
tools.description: Save explicit Qiongli provider config values from chat or scripts. Prefer qiongli_configure_provider for API keys.

tools.name: qiongli_open_config_wizard
tools.description: Compatibility alias for qiongli_configure_provider. Starts a local browser-based provider configuration wizard.

tools.name: qiongli_literature_search
tools.description: Search academic literature using configured OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar providers.

tools.name: qiongli_literature_export_evidence
tools.description: Export an auditable provider capability and search evidence snapshot.

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API key
openalex_api_key.description: OpenAlex API key from openalex.org/settings/api. Leave blank to skip OpenAlex provider calls.

openalex_email.title: OpenAlex email
openalex_email.description: Optional email address included in OpenAlex requests as mailto contact metadata.

semantic_scholar_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API key
semantic_scholar_api_key.description: Semantic Scholar API key. Leave blank to use only unauthenticated provider paths.

default_result_limit.title: Default result limit
default_result_limit.description: Default results per provider for non-review searches when a tool call does not specify a limit. Non-review mode uses 25 by default; review mode uses 50 by default and accepts explicit limits up to 100.
